title: DECISION: SSRF protection via host validation before network activity
description: is_valid_fetch_host guards outbound fetches by rejecting loopback, RFC 1918, link-local, and unspecified ranges before any network I/O. Defense-in-depth: prevents malicious peers from redirecting fetches to internal services (Redis, Postgres, APIs). Port 0 is explicitly rejected to prevent OS assignment. Hostname validation is separate from IP parsing to handle MagicDNS names correctly. Security rationale: one-way validation gate at the network boundary.
